slide_1.first_textbox: Over twelve months, multiple departments launched AI workflows for forecasting, quality monitoring, and support automation. Each release required governance checkpoints, regional policy reviews, and rollback criteria before production activation.
slide_1.second_textbox: Program leaders then unified operations metrics into one cadence, including incident trends, drift signals, false-positive investigations, staffing impacts, and cost-baseline tracking across business units.
slide_1.third_textbox: Approval gates across legal, platform, and operations were hard to synchronize
slide_1.fourth_textbox: Handoff quality varied when incident ownership boundaries were unclear
slide_1.fifth_textbox: Weekly remediation updates were required for executive oversight
